_readme: Headwords pinned to level 1 (A1 / TOPIK 1) regardless of what corpus frequency and the CEFR-J anchor say. These are almost all conversational: greetings, politeness formulas, yes/no and apologies. Written corpora structurally cannot rank them — Wikipedia and Global Voices never say hello — so `hola`, `bonjour` and `안녕하세요` came out at B1/B2, and multi-word ones like `por favor` and `s'il vous plaît` were never ranked at all, because the corpus tokenizer is single-token. Keep this list short and only for vocabulary whose absence from a beginner curriculum would be indefensible. Every entry must be a real dictionary headword; the build warns and skips anything that is not. See scripts/lib/coreOverrides.mjs.
